question: Find the top 10 drivers with the fastest average lap time (in seconds) across all races held in Monaco between 1980 and 2010. For each driver, return their full name and average lap time in seconds.

FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
JOIN races r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
JOIN circuits c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Monaco' AND r."XCL_066" BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY d."XCL_034", d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
ORDER BY avg_lap_time_seconds ASC
LIMIT 10
